msg: Try to click within the allocated time. A low score is better than no score. Try to keep concentrating, it can be easy to zone out and then forget to click. The red and purple people take you into one forest, the green and brown take you into a different forest. It felt as though staying with one forest for many turns was more successful than changing frequently between forests, but sometimes it appears completely random as to how many mushrooms you receive. I could not see a strict pattern - maybe there isn't one! Good luck!
